v1.name: V1 readiness
v1.summary: Customer and builder foundations exist, but real builder stalls, inconsistent premium design judging and missing repeated production website handoffs prevent 100% readiness.

v2.name: V2 readiness
v2.summary: Owner, worker, Brand Studio and connection recovery implementation advanced, but not all five workers have representative live outcomes or reliable broad recurring-operation proof.

v3.name: V3 / Full 10/10 vision
v3.summary: Website and operational code improved; complete SaaS delivery, automated custom-agent creation, measured economics, and low-founder-intervention evidence are still materially missing.

autonomyProof.note: Representative success/attempt denominator is still unavailable; do not imply the 95–99% V3 mature target has been measured.

founderWorkload.note: Darius minutes are not comprehensively separated from operator effort, customer approvals or specialist review.

dimensions.name: Business understanding & scope selection
dimensions.blocker: Real cross-industry scope accuracy and unsupported-scope refusal still lack a broad blind-tested customer sample.
dimensions.nextMilestone: Blind-test 20 varied businesses for accurate scope and refusals.

dimensions.name: Premium website delivery
dimensions.blocker: Recent production builder stalls and founder-rejected visual quality have not been followed by three consecutively verified premium live deliveries.
dimensions.nextMilestone: Prove 3 premium production website journeys with accepted design, revision, publication, handoff and one unattended recovery.

dimensions.name: Complete SaaS & existing-app engineering
dimensions.blocker: No verified complete customer SaaS build and existing-app change workflow covering auth, backend, data, billing and deployment.
dimensions.nextMilestone: Deliver one bounded complete SaaS and one governed existing-app change end to end.

dimensions.name: Standard AI workforce capability
dimensions.blocker: Merged recovery and integration code is not sufficient proof of useful live outcomes across Maya, Jordan, Avery, Alex and Richard.
dimensions.nextMilestone: Record owner-approved live provider outcomes across all 5 workers.

dimensions.name: Automated custom-agent delivery
dimensions.blocker: Custom-agent assessment and sandbox groundwork are not a verified autonomous custom-agent build, test, activation and monitoring cycle.
dimensions.nextMilestone: Prove one supported custom agent from requirements through independent tests, activation and handoff.

dimensions.name: Autonomous coordination & recovery
dimensions.blocker: Real stuck/reopened builder jobs have exposed ownership/research and retry issues; post-fix unattended end-to-end recovery is not proven.
dimensions.nextMilestone: Recover real stopped/parked website work without manual rescue or duplicate spend.

dimensions.name: Reliability, security & ongoing maintenance
dimensions.blocker: Recent deploy-helper and builder lock corrections merged, but current production revision, restart/restore and soak evidence remain incomplete.
dimensions.nextMilestone: Prove safe release, timed restore and multi-copy failure soak on the deployed revision.

dimensions.name: Complete customer journey & ownership
dimensions.blocker: Owner flows and Brand Studio improved, but repeatable paid build through revision, publishing, support, export and handoff is unverified.
dimensions.nextMilestone: Repeat full paid-like website journeys through revision, live handoff and ownership export.

dimensions.name: Commercial delivery & acquisition readiness
dimensions.blocker: Checkout and offers exist, but source-attributed real customer conversion and retention are not measured.
dimensions.nextMilestone: Verify real source-to-paid acquisition and ongoing customer delivery.

dimensions.name: Economic proof & low-founder-workload operation
dimensions.blocker: Paid delivery margins, failed-attempt costs, support burden and Darius hours are still not measured on a representative cohort.
dimensions.nextMilestone: Measure paid job margins and Darius intervention time on a representative cohort.

v1Remaining: Pass 3 consecutive premium website journeys on an identified production builder/app release with approved design, full build, revision, live publication and ownership handoff.
Calibrate independent website visual and motion review to reject founder-rejected output rather than relying on high automated scores.
Demonstrate unattended recovery from one real stopped or restarted website job, including preserved progress and accurate spend settlement.
Verify truthful owner-facing status and support, export/ownership and rollback on that same production release.
v2Remaining: Verify genuinely useful real-provider outcomes and safe approvals for Maya, Jordan, Avery, Alex and Richard.
Prove the supported configured integration set across varied business types (catalog availability is not live connectivity).
Prove ongoing maintenance, customer ownership and incident/restore operation, including measured founder, operator and customer-required actions.
biggestChange: Oct 22–23 merges improved Brand Studio preparation, customer-state clarity and owner/worker recovery, but none establishes repeatable premium website delivery or production proof of recent builder recovery fixes.
improvements: Business Builder PRs #672, #684, #685 and #686 merged Brand Studio galleries/preparation, corrected editor navigation and honest pre-start notices.
Business Builder PR #687 merged guarded owner/worker/financial/connection recovery on Oct 23, while follow-up PR #688 remains open.
Stromation PR #326 merged bounded stuck-job/lock hygiene; #328 merged safer release lock handling; latest on-demand builder PR #327 remains open.
regressions: A real builder job was parked after stale or invalid research and a separate job had unwritable lock symptoms; merged code does not yet show successful unattended production recovery.

An incorrect deployment-readiness import previously blocked a production promotion before any service changed; the helper fix merged, but successful production promotion of all recent merges is not independently established.
Real paid premium website acceptance and visual-motion judging remain insufficiently demonstrated, and automated reviewer scores have contradicted founder evaluation.

merged: Business Builder #672, #683–#687 are merged by Oct 23; #688 remains open and earns no implemented-capability credit.
Stromation #325, #326 and #328 are merged; #327 remains open and earns no implemented-capability credit.
deployed: Business Builder #683 reported healthy production at e99e8185, web :363 / worker :228, before a stopped promotion; #685 cited a later settled dc56c1be, API :366 / worker :231, as a rollback point. Latest merges are not independently verified live here.
Stromation #326 described real earlier job stalls; no independently observed repeat of three complete successful premium website deliveries after its merge.
verified: Brand Studio PR #672 reported 19 required CI passes on an earlier head and extensive offline browser/API suites; merge status is verified, but provider-backed customer acceptance is not.
PR #687 reported full local build and numerous unit/browser/API tests; merge is verified, but current deployment and live worker outcomes are not.
Stromation stuck-job code contains regression tests, but did not run a paid build or customer journey as part of its fix.

promisesOverreach: Do not present founder-rejected website designs rated 'ship' as proven premium quality.
Do not claim merged website/worker repairs are deployed or repeatedly proven without production evidence.
Do not claim complete arbitrary SaaS or autonomous custom-agent manufacturing.
Do not claim 95–99% unattended routine workflows, 1–2 Darius hours/week, or proven unit economics; these remain unmeasured.
founderWorkloadTrend: Unknown: no consistent measured time series separates Darius intervention from customer approval, specialist review or operator effort.
nextActions: Calibrate a motion-and-design-aware independent quality reviewer against founder-approved and founder-rejected samples.
Run 3 production premium website delivery journeys, including full revision, hosting, export and one controlled failure/restart, without hidden human rescue.
Record exact production revision, recovery/spend receipts and Darius/operator/customer-required time on those journeys.

assumptions: The website-builder asset/recovery defect is fixed and the merged repair release is deployed and repeatedly proven within roughly 30 days.
SelfOperate receives about 150–500 qualified prospects/visitors over 90 days.
Paid conversion is roughly 1–2% while the product remains supervised.
Supervised delivery capacity remains roughly 2–4 projects per month.
Roughly half to three-quarters of eligible delivered customers retain the $299/month ongoing SelfOperate service after any included period.
businessOutlook.note: This is not a reliable demand forecast yet. One-time website/business build revenue is excluded from MRR.

costReporting.measuredSpend: $0.42 for the full concept study in synthetic-test25-002; not the total run or delivery cost.
costReporting.reservedUnconfirmedSpend: Unknown from accessible evidence for the current run.
costReporting.note: Do not combine the $0.42 partial measured spend with older or overlapping estimates.

method: 2026-10-23 independent SelfOperate V1/V2/V3 rescore using canonical GitHub PR merge metadata, merged and open integrated Stromation builder PRs, recent owner/worker/Brand Studio acceptance claims and point-in-time production release evidence. No open PR credit; merged code is distinct from production deployment and repeat live proof. Forward estimates are conditional.
